```{=html}
<script>
// This page uses site-root links ("/styles.css", "/images/...") so that it works
// when GitHub serves it for ANY missing address (e.g. /notes/x/y). When the file
// itself is opened (address ends in 404.html: a local file, an editor preview, or
// https://jackrthomas.github.io/404.html) those links may point to the wrong
// place, so rewrite them relative to this file and re-load the styles/scripts.
(function () {
  if (!/\/404\.html$/.test(location.pathname)) return;
  var base = location.href.replace(/[^/]*([?#].*)?$/, "");       // this file's folder
  if (base === location.origin + "/") return;                   // at the site root: links already fine
  function fix(url) { return url.replace(/^\/(\.\/)?/, base); }
  function rewrite(root) {
    root.querySelectorAll('link[href^="/"]:not([href^="//"])').forEach(function (el) {
      var n = el.cloneNode(); n.href = fix(el.getAttribute("href")); el.replaceWith(n);
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('script[src^="/"]:not([src^="//"])').forEach(function (el) {
      var n = document.createElement("script");
      n.src = fix(el.getAttribute("src")); n.async = false;     // keep execution order
      el.replaceWith(n);
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('img[src^="/"]:not([src^="//"])').forEach(function (el) {
      el.src = fix(el.getAttribute("src"));
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/"]:not([href^="//"])').forEach(function (el) {
      el.href = fix(el.getAttribute("href"));
    });
  }
  rewrite(document);                                             // head + navbar
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { rewrite(document.body); });
})();

// Old-site addresses (jack.thomaslabs.co.uk) -> new locations. If the missing
// address matches one of these, forward the visitor instead of showing the 404.
(function () {
  var p = decodeURIComponent(location.pathname);
  var MOVED = [
    [/^\/Notes\/posts\/PDE@umn\/?/i,    "/notes/posts/locality-interatomic/"],
    [/^\/Notes\/posts\/body-order\/?/i, "/notes/posts/body-ordered/"],
    [/^\/Notes\/?(.*)$/,                "/notes/$1"],       // capital N -> lower case
    [/^\/teaching\/?$/,                 "/teaching.html"],
    [/^\/L'Aquila\/?/,                  "/notes/posts/screening-rhf/"]
  ];
  for (var i = 0; i < MOVED.length; i++) {
    if (MOVED[i][0].test(p)) {
      location.replace(p.replace(MOVED[i][0], MOVED[i][1]) + location.hash);
      return;
    }
  }
})();
</script>
```
